title: Microbiota-driven therapeutic efficacy of Hyperoside in ulcerative colitis and associated anxiety.
authors: Yin, Li; Xu, Lin; Shan, Yu-Nan; He, Zhilin; Li, Yanbin; Chen, Wei
journal: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金丝桃苷对溃疡性结肠炎及焦虑的疗效，涉及分子对接但核心为肠道菌群与代谢通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ulcerative colitis (UC) is subtype of inflammatory bowel disease that is frequently comorbid with anxiety disorders. However, effective dual-targeting therapies are still lacking. Hyperoside (HYP), a natural flavonoid, exhibits anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective properties, yet its potential therapeutic effects on UC and associated anxiety, as well as the underlying mechanisms, remain largely unexplored. METHODS: A murine model of DSS-induced colitis was established and treated with HYP. Disease activity was assessed through body weight, colon length, and histopathology. Anxiety-like behaviors were evaluated using open field and elevated plus maze tests. Neuroinflammation was examined through immunohistochemistry of BDNF expression and microglial activation. Gut microbiota composition was profiled by metagenomic sequencing, and metabolomic profiling was conducted using the Q300 Kit. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were employed to predict signaling pathways, which were further validated by Western blotting. Additionally, antibiotic depletion experiments were conducted to determine microbiota dependency. RESULTS: HYP administration significantly ameliorated DSS-induced colitis, as evidenced by attenuated weight loss, restored colon length, and improved histopathology. It suppressed pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta) and restored intestinal barrier integrity by upregulating Mucin-2 and ZO-1. Furthermore, HYP also alleviated anxiety-like behaviors and mitigated neuroinflammation by increasing BDNF levels and suppressing microglial activation. HYP treatment also restored gut microbial homeostasis, enriching beneficial bacteria such as Enterobacter ludwigii while reducing the abundance of Enterobacter hormaechei, Escherichia coli, and Acinetobacter baumannii. Metabolomic analysis revealed that HYP significantly promoted arginine biosynthesis. Network pharmacology and molecular docking identified the MAPK, PI3K-Akt, and NF-kappaB pathways as potential targets, with HYP showing strong binding affinity to MAPK3, AKT1, and NFkappaB1. Importantly, the therapeutic effects of HYP were abolished in microbiota-depleted mice. CONCLUSION: Our findings demonstrate that HYP effectively alleviates DSS-induced colitis and comorbid anxiety-like behaviors. Its efficacy is dependent on the gut microbiota and is associated with the restoration of microbial homeostasis, enhancement of arginine metabolism, and modulation of the MAPK/PI3K-Akt/NF-kappaB signaling pathways. HYP represents a promising microbiota-targeting therapeutic candidate for UC and its neuropsychiatric comorbidities.
abstract_zh: 背景：溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）是炎症性肠病的一种亚型，常与焦虑障碍共病。然而，有效的双靶向治疗仍缺乏。金丝桃苷（Hyperoside, HYP）是一种天然黄酮类化合物，具有抗炎和神经保护特性，但其对UC及相关焦虑的潜在治疗作用及潜在机制仍 largely 未被探索。方法：建立DSS诱导的小鼠结肠炎模型，并给予HYP治疗。通过体重、结肠长度和组织病理学评估疾病活动度。使用旷场实验和高架十字迷宫实验评估焦虑样行为。通过免疫组化检测BDNF表达和小胶质细胞活化来检查神经炎症。通过宏基因组测序分析肠道菌群组成，并使用Q300试剂盒进行代谢组学分析。采用网络药理学和分子对接预测信号通路，并通过Western blotting进一步验证。此外，进行抗生素耗竭实验以确定菌群依赖性。结果：HYP给药显著改善DSS诱导的结肠炎，表现为体重减轻缓解、结肠长度恢复和组织病理学改善。它抑制促炎细胞因子（TNF-alpha、IL-6、IL-1beta），并通过上调Mucin-2和ZO-1恢复肠道屏障完整性。此外，HYP还通过增加BDNF水平和抑制小胶质细胞活化，缓解焦虑样行为并减轻神经炎症。HYP治疗还恢复了肠道微生物稳态，富集了有益菌如Enterobacter ludwigii，同时减少了Enterobacter hormaechei、Escherichia coli和Acinetobacter baumannii的丰度。代谢组学分析显示，HYP显著促进精氨酸生物合成。网络药理学和分子对接将MAPK、PI3K-Akt和NF-kappaB通路确定为潜在靶点，HYP对MAPK3、AKT1和NFkappaB1显示出强结合亲和力。重要的是，在菌群耗竭小鼠中，HYP的治疗效果被消除。结论：我们的研究结果表明，HYP有效缓解DSS诱导的结肠炎及共病焦虑样行为。其疗效依赖于肠道菌群，并与恢复微生物稳态、增强精氨酸代谢以及调节MAPK/PI3K-Akt/NF-kappaB信号通路相关。HYP是UC及其神经精神共病的一种有前景的靶向菌群治疗候选药物。
